sn56.41:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn56.41:1.3: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave aññataro puriso rājagahā nikkhamitvā lokacintaṃ cintessāmīti yena sumāgadhā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā sumāgadhāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre nisīdi lokacintaṃ cintento.
sn56.41:1.4: addasā kho bhikkhave so puriso sumāgadhāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ bhisamuḷālaṃ pavisantaṃ.
sn56.41:1.7: yaṃ loke natthi taṃ mayā diṭṭhanti.
sn56.41:2.1: atha kho so bhikkhave puriso nagaraṃ pavisitvā mahājanakāyassa ārocesi
sn56.41:2.2: ummattosmi nāmāhaṃ bhante vicetosmi nāmāhaṃ bhante
sn56.41:2.3: yaṃ loke natthi taṃ mayā diṭṭhanti.
sn56.41:2.4: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ ambho purisa ummatto kathaṃ viceto
sn56.41:2.6: idhāhaṃ bhante rājagahā nikkhamitvā lokacintaṃ cintessāmīti yena sumāgadhā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā sumāgadhāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre nisīdiṃ lokacintaṃ cintento.
sn56.41:2.7: addasaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante sumāgadhāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ bhisamuḷālaṃ pavisantaṃ.
sn56.41:2.8: evaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante ummatto evaṃ viceto
sn56.41:2.9: idañca loke natthi yaṃ mayā diṭṭhanti.
sn56.41:2.10: taggha tvaṃ ambho purisa ummatto taggha viceto
sn56.41:2.11: idañca loke natthi yaṃ tayā diṭṭhanti.
sn56.41:3.1: taṃ kho pana bhikkhave so puriso bhūtaṃyeva addasa no abhūtaṃ.
sn56.41:3.3: tasmiṃ kho pana bhikkhave saṅgāme devā jiniṃsu asurā parājiniṃsu.
sn56.41:3.4: parājitā ca kho bhikkhave asurā bhītā bhisamuḷālena asurapuraṃ pavisiṃsu devānaṃyeva mohayamānā.
sn56.41:4.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave mā lokacintaṃ cintetha
sn56.41:4.2: sassato lokoti vā asassato lokoti vā antavā lokoti vā anantavā lokoti vā taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti vā aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti vā hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā.
sn56.41:4.4: nesā bhikkhave cintā atthasañhitā na ādibrahmacariyakā na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati.
sn56.41:5.1: cintentā ca kho tumhe bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhanti cinteyyātha …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti cinteyyātha.
sn56.41:5.3: esā bhikkhave cintā atthasañhitā esā ādibrahmacariyakā esā nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
sn56.41:6.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
